# Feature `image:post-install-logging`

Image feature `post-install-logging`:

Enables logging postinstall script runs to the `/var/log/postinstall.log` file on first boot of the image on the target system.

Note

To make the `/var/log` directory on the target persistent, use the VOLATILE_LOG_DIR variable by setting it to “no”.
